Giving Test Guide

Help us test the new giving page before it goes live

We've built a new way for people to give to the church online. Before we share it with everyone, we'd love a few of you to try it and tell us how it goes. It takes about three minutes. Please read the important note first.

Important — please read

This is a test. No real money will be taken. You must use the test card below. Please do not use your own bank card.

4242 4242 4242 4242
Expiry: any future date, e.g. 12 / 34  ·  Security code: any 3 digits, e.g. 123  ·  Postcode: any, e.g. M13 9EE
Open the giving page on your phone:
calvaryhfgc.github.io/calvaryhephzibah/give/

Walk through it

1

Choose your amount

Pick an amount, or type your own. Then choose whether it's a one-off gift or one that repeats every month.

2

Fund & Gift Aid

Choose which fund your gift is for. If you're a UK taxpayer, turn on Gift Aid — this lets the church claim an extra 25% from HMRC at no cost to you. If you turn it on, fill in your name, home address and postcode, because Gift Aid needs these.

3

Check and continue

Make sure the summary looks right, then tap Give. You'll be taken to a secure payment page.

4

Pay with the test card

You'll land on Stripe's secure checkout — the safe, standard payment page used by many organisations. Enter the test card from the top of this guide: 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future expiry, any 3-digit code, then pay.

Remember: test card only. Never your real card.

5

The thank-you page

After paying you'll see a thank-you screen with a link to our most recent sermon, and buttons to follow us on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. Please tap them and check they open the right places.

What to check

  • The page opened on your phone and looked right
  • You could choose an amount and pick one-off or monthly
  • Gift Aid turned on and asked for your address
  • The secure payment page loaded
  • The test card was accepted
  • You saw the thank-you page
  • The sermon link opened our sermons
  • The Instagram, TikTok and YouTube buttons opened the right pages

If you have time, also try

  • A different amount, and a monthly gift
  • Once with Gift Aid on, and once with it off
  • On a different phone if you have one (iPhone and Android)

How to let us know

Send us a quick message with: what worked, anything that looked wrong or confusing, and a screenshot of anything that didn't work. Please tell us which phone you used (iPhone or Android). Thank you for helping.
